title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In Colombia in 2025, ICSP strengthened climate‑resilient local economic systems and food security for more than 150,000 people in La Guajira by advancing a sustainable Blue Economy. Artisanal fishers benefited from improved gear, energy‑efficient engines, and cold‑chain systems that increased income stability and reduced environmental pressure. Ecosystem stewardship improved through co‑management with National Natural Parks, supporting healthier marine resources for household nutrition. The multi‑hazard Ranchería River EWS, operated by 50 Wayuu River Watchers across 14 monitoring points, enhanced preparedness for climate and water‑related hazards, safeguarding fishing and pastoral livelihoods and strengthening local food‑system resilience.. Strengthening climate‑resilient local economic systems and food security through the Resilience of the Blue Economy programme
